cause.zh: 在‘贝克’(Baker) 水下核爆中受到极其严重的船体结构损伤。在核爆结束后的第五天夜里，由于进水过多，在无人目击的情况下默默倾覆沉没于环礁湖底。
cause.en: Suffered extremely severe hull structural damage during the 'Baker' underwater nuclear test. On the night of the fifth day after the detonation, due to excessive flooding, she quietly capsized and sank to the bottom of the lagoon unobserved.

depth.en: Approx. 50 meters (Capsized/Upside down on the seabed)

historyNotes.zh: 曾是日本联合舰队的旗舰，山本五十六正是从这艘船上发出了偷袭珍珠港的‘虎！虎！虎！’指令。作为日本投降时唯一一艘能够航行的战列舰，它的沉没标志着日本帝国海军的彻底终结。
historyNotes.en: Once the flagship of the Japanese Combined Fleet, from which Isoroku Yamamoto issued the 'Tora! Tora! Tora!' order to attack Pearl Harbor. As the only survivable Japanese battleship capable of sailing at the time of Japan's surrender, her sinking marked the absolute end of the Imperial Japanese Navy.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 距离‘贝克’水下核爆中心仅 155 米。核爆瞬间产生的超强水下冲击波和数百万吨重的水柱直接将其压碎并掀翻，几乎在瞬间沉入海底。
cause.en: Positioned just 155 meters from the 'Baker' underwater nuclear blast center. The incredibly powerful underwater shockwave and millions of tons of water column generated instantly by the explosion directly crushed and flipped her over, causing her to sink almost instantaneously.

historyNotes.zh: 这是美国海军参加一战和二战的骨灰级老将（1912年服役）。由于距离爆心极近，它的残骸在海底被倒扣着深深砸进沙子里，船体结构被核爆巨大的能量撕扯得极其扭曲。
historyNotes.en: A veteran of both WWI and WWII for the U.S. Navy (commissioned in 1912). Due to being extremely close to the hypocenter, her wreck was slammed upside down deep into the sand on the seabed, with her hull structure severely twisted by the immense energy of the nuclear explosion.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 在‘贝克’水下核爆中，遭到相当于两万吨 TNT 当量的巨大冲击波打击。飞行甲板受重创，船体大规模漏水，于核爆后约 7 个半小时沉没。
cause.en: During the 'Baker' underwater nuclear test, she was struck by a massive shockwave equivalent to 20,000 tons of TNT. Her flight deck was severely damaged and the hull suffered massive flooding, sinking approximately seven and a half hours after the detonation.

historyNotes.zh: 世界最顶级的沉船潜水胜地。巨大的舰体依然保持直立，甚至机库内搭载用于测试的复仇者式鱼雷机、炸弹以及各类军事设备至今依然排列在漆黑的深海中。
historyNotes.en: One of the world's premier shipwreck diving destinations. The massive hull still sits upright, and even the Avenger torpedo bombers, bombs, and various military equipment loaded in the hangar for the test remain arranged in the pitch-black deep sea to this day.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 在代号‘阿贝’ (Able) 的空中核爆中，距离爆心点过近（由于炸弹偏离原定目标）。核闪光引燃了上层建筑，强烈的冲击波撕裂了舰体艉部。次日在被美军拖船尝试拖拽时沉没。
cause.en: During the 'Able' atmospheric nuclear test, she was too close to the hypocenter (due to the bomb missing its intended target). The nuclear flash ignited her superstructure, and the intense shockwave tore apart her stern. She sank the next day while U.S. tugboats were attempting to tow her.

historyNotes.zh: 阿贺野级轻巡洋舰，日本在二战末期完工的新锐战舰。它几乎没有参与任何实战便迎来终战，最终作为靶舰在第一场核试验中便被彻底摧毁。
historyNotes.en: An Agano-class light cruiser, a state-of-the-art warship completed by Japan late in WWII. She saw almost no combat before the war ended, and was ultimately completely destroyed as a target ship in the very first nuclear test.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 为了测试核爆对水下目标的破坏力，被安排在水下潜航状态接受测试。‘贝克’水下核爆的巨大水压瞬间压垮了其耐压壳，导致其永久沉没。
cause.en: To test the destructive power of a nuclear explosion on underwater targets, she was arranged to be submerged during the test. The immense water pressure from the 'Baker' underwater nuclear blast instantly crushed her pressure hull, causing her to sink permanently.

historyNotes.zh: 一艘战功卓著的巴劳鱵级潜艇。目前它的残骸极其完好地静卧在比基尼环礁的沙地上，指挥塔上甚至还能看到核试验前涂上的清晰编号。
historyNotes.en: A highly decorated Balao-class submarine. Currently, her remarkably intact wreck rests quietly on the sandy bottom of Bikini Atoll, and the clearly painted identification numbers applied before the test can still be seen on her conning tower.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 在‘阿贝’空中核爆中，由于距离爆炸中心点仅 400 米，剧烈的爆炸冲击波瞬间引发大火并导致船体破裂。在爆炸后几分钟内迅速向左舷翻覆沉没。
cause.en: During the 'Able' atmospheric nuclear test, being only 400 meters from ground zero, the violent shockwave instantly sparked massive fires and ruptured her hull. She rapidly capsized to port and sank within minutes of the explosion.

historyNotes.zh: 曾参加过珊瑚海海战和中途岛海战，并在中途岛海战中负责救援约克城号的幸存者并最终将其击沉。现在，它与曾经的战友们一起长眠于太平洋。
historyNotes.en: A veteran of the Battles of the Coral Sea and Midway. At Midway, she was responsible for rescuing survivors from USS Yorktown and ultimately scuttling the carrier. Now, she rests eternally in the Pacific alongside her former comrades.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 同样在‘阿贝’空中核爆中受损。核冲击波扫平了整个上层建筑结构并破坏了水密性，在核爆发生后的数小时内翻覆沉入礁湖。
cause.en: Also damaged in the 'Able' atmospheric nuclear test. The nuclear shockwave leveled her entire superstructure and compromised her watertight integrity. She capsized and sank into the lagoon within hours after the explosion.

historyNotes.zh: 由于沉没在相对较浅的水域且水质清澈，这艘马汉级驱逐舰的残骸目前也是非常受欢迎的技术潜水点，它的防空炮和鱼雷发射管仍清晰可见。
historyNotes.en: Sinking in relatively shallow, crystal-clear water, the wreck of this Mahan-class destroyer is currently a highly popular technical diving site, with her anti-aircraft guns and torpedo tubes still clearly visible.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 奇迹般地抗过了两次比基尼核爆。但因受到极高剂量的核辐射污染，美军无法派人登舰修补漏水。在被拖曳至夸贾林环礁 (Kwajalein Atoll) 后，最终因进水倾覆沉没。
cause.en: Miraculously survived both Bikini nuclear blasts. However, due to extreme levels of radioactive contamination, the U.S. Navy could not send personnel aboard to repair leaks. After being towed to Kwajalein Atoll, she ultimately capsized and sank due to flooding.

depth.zh: 约 11 米 (螺旋桨露出水面)

historyNotes.zh: 它并未直接沉没在比基尼环礁，而是沉没在东南方的夸贾林环礁。作为德国纳粹海军最后幸存的巨舰，它倒扣在极浅的水中，两只巨大的青铜螺旋桨至今刺破水面。
historyNotes.en: She did not sink directly at Bikini Atoll, but rather at Kwajalein Atoll to the southeast. As the last surviving capital ship of the Nazi German Navy, she lies upside down in very shallow water, with her two massive bronze propellers still piercing the water's surface today.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 在‘阿贝’ (Able) 空中核爆中，由于轰炸机投弹严重偏离原定靶心（内华达号），原子弹几乎正正在该舰上方引爆。船体瞬间受到极其恐怖的破坏，在不到 2 分钟内迅速沉没。
cause.en: During the 'Able' atmospheric nuclear test, because the bomber dropped the weapon significantly off the intended target (USS Nevada), the atomic bomb detonated almost directly above this ship. The hull instantly suffered horrifying damage, sinking rapidly in less than 2 minutes.

historyNotes.zh: 十字路口行动中第一艘沉没的战舰。它意外地成为了阿贝核爆真正的‘零点’（Ground Zero）。其被彻底压碎的船体目前躺在环礁湖底。
historyNotes.en: The first ship to sink during Operation Crossroads. It accidentally became the true 'Ground Zero' for the Able test. Its completely crushed hull lies on the lagoon floor.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 在‘阿贝’ (Able) 空中核爆中，距离爆心非常近。核冲击波将其整个上层建筑向一侧推平，船身受到严重破坏并起火，在核爆后半小时内沉没。
cause.en: Located very close to ground zero during the 'Able' atmospheric nuclear test. The nuclear blast wave flattened her entire superstructure to one side; the hull was severely damaged and caught fire, sinking within half an hour of the detonation.

historyNotes.zh: 阿贝空中核爆的另一位牺牲品。在沉入环礁湖之前，剧烈的冲击波甚至使其发生了物理位移。
historyNotes.en: Another victim of the Able air burst. The sheer force of the blast wave physically displaced the ship before it sank into the lagoon.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 在‘贝克’ (Baker) 水下核爆测试中，处于水下潜航状态。相当于两万吨 TNT 当量的巨大水压峰值瞬间压裂了潜艇的耐压外壳，导致其永久沉没。
cause.en: Submerged during the 'Baker' underwater nuclear test. The massive peak water pressure, equivalent to a 20-kiloton TNT blast, instantly ruptured the submarine's pressure hull, leading to her permanent sinking.

historyNotes.zh: 一艘从太平洋战争中幸存的巴劳鱵级潜艇，最终却成为了水压测试的模型。目前它半埋在沙子里，与其他巨大的战舰遗骸并列。
historyNotes.en: A Balao-class submarine that survived the Pacific War only to be used as a pressure test dummy. It rests partially buried in the sand next to other massive warships.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 同样在‘贝克’ (Baker) 水下核爆测试中被作为水下目标。被数百万吨被核爆掀起的海水和恐怖的水下冲击波直接压碎结构而沉没。
cause.en: Also used as a submerged target in the 'Baker' underwater nuclear test. She was directly structurally crushed and sunk by the terrifying underwater shockwave and the millions of tons of seawater displaced by the blast.

historyNotes.zh: 一艘较老的鲑鱼级潜艇。它被系泊在爆心附近的水下，专门用来测试潜艇外壳对水下核爆的生存能力。
historyNotes.en: An older Salmon-class submarine. It was moored submerged near the blast center to test hull survivability against underwater nuclear detonations.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

cause.zh: 在‘阿贝’空中核爆中幸存但受到辐射污染。随后在‘贝克’水下核爆中，其庞大的体积使其承受了极大的破坏力，船坞壁被冲击波撕裂并最终沉没。
cause.en: Survived the 'Able' atmospheric nuclear test but was radiologically contaminated. Subsequently, in the 'Baker' underwater test, its massive volume caused it to absorb tremendous destructive force; the dock walls were torn apart by the shockwave, and it eventually sank.

historyNotes.zh: 它不是一艘战舰，而是一个浮动干船坞。将其纳入测试是为了观察后勤支援基础设施如何承受核打击。这座庞大的结构现在是比基尼潜水胜地的一大特色。
historyNotes.en: Not a warship, but a floating dry dock. Its inclusion in the test was to see how support infrastructure would hold up to a nuclear strike. The massive structure is now a unique feature of the Bikini dive site.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)

name.zh: 比基尼环礁：十字路口核爆纪念碑

cause.zh: 在这个曾经宁静的太平洋环礁，人类先后引爆了两枚两万吨当量的原子弹（空中爆震与水下爆发），以测试末日武器对现代舰队的绝对毁灭能力。
cause.en: In this once-tranquil Pacific atoll, humanity detonated two 20-kiloton atomic bombs (an atmospheric detonation and an underwater burst) to test the absolute destructive capability of doomsday weapons against a modern fleet.

historyNotes.zh: 这是一个特殊的历史纪念标。1946 年，美军在此集结了近百艘二战功勋战舰（以及缴获的轴心国巨舰）作为核武器的靶舰。随着剧烈的核闪光与冲天而起的海啸，数十艘钢铁巨兽被瞬间融化或压碎，永远留在了海底。这场行动不仅彻底终结了巨舰大炮时代，也迫使比基尼岛的原住民永远告别了他们世代居住的家园。这里是二战的终点，也是人类正式迈入冷战核威慑纪元的‘零点’。
historyNotes.en: This is a special historical memorial marker. In 1946, the U.S. military assembled nearly a hundred decorated WWII warships (along with captured Axis behemoths) here as target ships for nuclear weapons. With fierce nuclear flashes and sky-high tsunamis, dozens of steel leviathans were instantly melted or crushed, remaining on the seabed forever. This operation not only completely ended the era of big guns and heavy armor but also forced the indigenous people of Bikini to permanently bid farewell to their ancestral home. This place marks the end of WWII and the 'Ground Zero' where humanity officially stepped into the era of Cold War nuclear deterrence.

battle.zh: 十字路口行动 (战后核试验)
